meta.description: Combined economic data for the SEA Dashboard. Merges World Bank official annual actuals (2015–2024) with IMF/WB forecast estimates (2025–2026) for cells where WB has not yet published official data. Always prefer official_actual values over forecast_estimate.

badge_guide.official_actual: Show 'Official' badge (green) — confirmed World Bank data
badge_guide.forecast_estimate: Show 'Estimate' badge (amber) — IMF/WB forecast, subject to revision
badge_guide.missing_official: Show 'No data' badge (grey) — neither official nor forecast available

meta.important_note: 2025/2026 values may be unavailable in official annual datasets. Forecasts are labeled separately and should not be treated as confirmed actual data. Official values are updated as World Bank publishes them (typically 1–2 year lag).
